name: plan_generation_constraints
why: Rubric §2: Nora's plan must respect intake constraints (injury, availability, recurring preference) — enforced by deterministic schema/rail validation of the LLM's structured output, not by trusting prose. Mirrors the onboarding prototype's 'Your first week' preview.

must_include.id: warmup as a phase-tagged exercise in the same list
must_include.reason: the player renders phase as a label on the exercise, not a separate screen (PRD R19)
rubric §4 demonstration links; the URL comes from the seed exercise library, never from the LLM (PRD R20/R22)
the player shows one instruction line per exercise (PRD R20)
the kept Saturday run is a standing activity, not a prescribed training day — 4 training days + 1 kept run = 5 scheduled activities (PRD R18a)

the number of exercises in a session is an output of generation, varying with minutes_per_session, goal and equipment — never a fixed count. Any UI string quoting a count reads it from the session it points to (PRD R6a, R24a).

every activity carries a source: 'nora' (a prescribed training day, counted against days_available_per_week), 'trainee_adhoc' (user-added), or 'standing_preference' (a kept recurring activity, excluded from the count). The 4-training-days-plus-1-kept-run split is unimplementable without the third value (PRD R24b, R18a).
